Reference / testing/signal

testing/signal#

Signals for tests: nothing comes until the test raises one.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let signals = ManualSignals();
let interruption = Interruption(source: signals);
signals.raise(CaughtSignal.interrupt);
interruption.check();                   // throws Interrupted.signal(interrupt)

Description#

Signals for tests: nothing comes until the test raises one.

The first signal raised is the one kept, as with the process's own. It works only inside a test.

Public API#
